desc:
When you are ready to up your trap shooting game with a dedicated shotgun, the new Citori 825 Trap will take you to the next level. This trap shooting machine has the handling, must-have features, and durability needed for practice and competition.
The raised Monte Carlo comb puts your eye in direct alignment with the wide rib and HiViz Pro-Comp fiber-optic front sight. A vertical pistol grip with palm swell and adjustable Triple Trigger System aid in obtaining a consistent set-up between shots.
The new Citori 825 is the latest in the storied lineage of Browning over and under shotguns that began with John M. Browning and his legendary B25 Superposed. This new model shares a number of features with the original, the most important being the easy handling prowess that feels nothing short of intuitive. It is quick to the shoulder, natural to point, and effortless to swing.
